scope: Second measured retention wave set on the same three artifacts, with the code slice widened from 42 to 61 tasks so the negative sign had power.
decoding: temperature 0, one prompt per row, max_tokens 1024
serve_config: -c 8192 --parallel 4 --jinja --no-webui --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8134 (CUDA llama-server from llama.cpp-dspark/build-cuda, 2048 tokens per slot)

sas15.edit: shared sign-aligned rank-1 refusal axis on o_proj + mlp.down_proj, served as a llama.cpp adapter on the unmodified base at scale 1.5 (POST /lora-adapters id 0 scale 1.5), verified cross-layer cos 1.000 across all 28 layers on both modules
sas15.certified_removal: 40/40 in-sample + 24/24 held-out refusal families + harmless clean, at the pinned 4096/4 config (v4_signaligned@1.5)

gpu: RTX 3060 12GiB, exactly one server at a time
grading: scripts/capability_wave.py through jdewitt.evaluation.score_response; deterministic scorers only, zero judge calls; a row whose generation failed is never a pass
comparisons: compare-base-vs-sas15-math.json, compare-base-vs-sas15-code.json, compare-base-vs-josiefied.json (jdewitt.cli score-compare, R9 gate satisfied without --allow-config-mismatch), format-audit.json (paired block)
why_this_set_exists: On the 42-task code slice the SAS delta was -0.238 with overlapping Wilson intervals (paired p 0.0675): a point estimate, not a finding. At 61 tasks the same edit reads -0.213 with family-level sign test p 0.0146 and paired permutation p 0.017.
